capabilities: Plan day, week, and month tasks with subtasks, drag-and-drop, and carry-forward
Run daily or backdated reviews with editable question flows
Generate weekly and monthly reports plus an AI profile from accumulated loops
Analyze up to 30 existing daily notes into a third-person portrait with date-level evidence
Refresh planning suggestions after a review
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat sidebar; the AI runs inside the Plan → Review loop and only reads notes when the user clicks.
extras: Freemium: free tier gives 3 daily insights per month and only the first 2 enabled review questions; Pro (¥19/month or ¥168/year, 3 devices per license) adds the full question flow, weekly/monthly reports, AI portrait, and 200 conversations per month, capped at 4M input / 800K output tokens monthly. AI runs on TideLog's hosted server: prompts and note content are sent there, checked, and forwarded to a model provider; the server keeps no note or response bodies but logs quota and abuse-prevention data. License keys are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage and revalidated in the background at startup. Source is AGPL v3.0 with commercial terms for Pro. International payment is still being prepared; users are asked to request it via GitHub Issues. Upgrade to 1.2.1+ before December 5, 2026 for continued service.
intentEvidence: Most AI note plugins hand you a chat box — the same chat box on day 1 and on day 300.
motivation: The author says many people write daily notes, plans, and reflections, but the notes rarely return to change what they do next, so TideLog adds the missing loop.
problem: Daily notes, plans, and reflections accumulate in the vault but rarely feed back into what the user does next.

requires.name: TideLog Pro license for full Review, Insights, and AI features

summary: Obsidian plugin that turns daily notes into a Plan → Review → Insights loop, with AI-generated weekly and monthly reports and an evidence-backed profile of the user.
